title: Canon Recovery Ledger v2
description: Schema for the canon-recovery-ledger.jsonl. Each line is one JSON object. The existing 1,204 v1 entries are treated as untrusted migration input.

id.description: Unique ledger entry ID. Format: R-{prototype_id}-{hash}

field_path.description: Dot/bracket path to the canon field, e.g. performance_data[0].verification_quote. Array indices are transient location hints, NOT identity.

record_identity.description: Stable identity of the matched record (design §6.2). Must include level and key.

applied_commit.description: Git commit SHA where this change was applied, or 'PENDING' for unapplied v1 entries. R1+ entries must have a real commit SHA.

source_file.description: Repository-relative path to the source PDF/JSON

quote.description: Exact text excerpt from the source (not a title or paraphrase)

locator.description: Reproducible page/section/figure locator in the source

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this entry was created

metadata.description: Free-form metadata for corrective entries (e.g. corruption_removed, downgrades_applied)
